summary: Implemented the complete proposed NCCL one-sided RMA surface: ctypes bindings and strict NCCL >= 2.30/full-symbol capability gating, registered-window handle retention, and an NcclRmaCommunicator all-rank ring warm-up. Added compatibility fixes for mixed/partial libraries, checked NCCL return codes, retained wait-descriptor storage, separated warm-up source and destination slots, and made the embedded allocator link against RCCL on ROCm. The prepared one-GPU AMD node verified the rebuilt native allocator and its numerical behavior, but cannot execute the two-rank NCCL RMA protocol.

tests.what_was_measured: 15 compatibility/ABI/adversarial tests passed; two real two-GPU RMA tests skipped because only one GPU is assigned. Raw output: /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-1a96e134f3be/logs/test_pynccl_rma.log

Recompiled and loaded /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-1a96e134f3be/build/symm_allocator/nccl_allocator.so against pinned RCCL; verified nccl_allocator_get_windows_for_comm and nccl_allocator_clear_windows_for_comm exports. Raw output: /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-1a96e134f3be/logs/native_allocator_rebuild_rccl.log

On AMD Instinct MI350X, a tensor allocated from the rebuilt NCCL/RCCL memory pool matched an independent CPU arange-square-plus-three reference exactly (max_abs_diff=0.0), and pool membership was confirmed. Raw output: /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-1a96e134f3be/logs/gpu_allocator_numerical.log
Repository formatting, static checks, codespell, and registered-test taxonomy all passed.

Pinned RCCL is 2.27.7 and lacks ncclPutSignal, ncclSignal, ncclWaitSignal, ncclWinGetUserPtr, and ncclGetPeerDevicePointer; has_rma correctly remained false. Raw output: /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-1a96e134f3be/logs/rccl_capability.log

remaining_limitations: The assigned node has one AMD GPU, so the required two-rank handle exchange and ring put_signal/wait_signal protocol could not run.
Pinned RCCL 2.27.7 lacks all five requested RMA symbols, so neither the successful RMA path nor a runtime NULL-window-handle fallback was independently exercised.
NVIDIA NCCL >= 2.30, NVLink hardware, PCIe-only NVIDIA hardware, and vGPU paths are unavailable in this environment.

NcclRmaCommunicator provides and validates the requested primitive/warm-up abstraction but is not wired into an SGLang TP/EP production collective path; the source proposal did not request replacing an existing collective.
